set.body:
Owner: design shared. Acceptance:
- TrialDrivePlan retains TrialId/ConditionId/run, full pulse semantics, event/phase provenance, acquisition rows and original output ordering after onset sorting.
- One-hot membership, active condition counts, empty/singleton conditions and repeated phases sharing one coefficient are explicit; no string-parsed identities.
- Forward/adjoint and first/mixed-second kernel products agree with direct designs for impulses, off-grid times, box height/mass, repeated drives and run resets.
- Shared weights/noise transform/mask produce a geometry fingerprint; v1 excludes unsupported voxel-specific geometry without silently pooling it.
- State admission checks complete drive realization; independent onset/offset shocks cannot represent one random box amplitude. JVM+JS scenario contracts pass.
Performance: build intersections/bands directly and cache event geometry once; no dense T*N design per voxel. Cache identity includes temporal preparation and integration conventions.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: PHRF-05: Compile trial drives with stable axes and observation geometry
